description:
Rivo is envisioned as a living sculpture, where architecture flows with elegance and balance. Its design merges clean white contours, warm wood accents, and expansive glass facades, creating an impression of movement and calm. Each level appears to float above the next, with curves that soften the structure’s presence and invite natural light into every residence. description:

Set within the vibrant heart of Meydan, the development blends stylish architecture with urban functionality, offering residents direct access to one of Dubai’s most well-connected and rapidly evolving districts. With views of the skyline and convenient routes to key landmarks, the project captures the essence of contemporary Dubai living, where convenience, design, and community come together effortlessly.

Carefully designed leisure decks, landscaped outdoor zones, and elevated podium experiences create a dynamic environment for relaxation, wellness, and recreation. description:

description:

The development features three sculptural towers rising in elegant harmony along the waterfront, with flowing balconies, soft curves, and lush sky gardens that blur the line between nature and structure. Open-plan living areas flow toward panoramic windows framing the city and water views, while muted tones and tactile materials bring warmth and sophistication. description:

Optimally situated at the Dubai Harbour, each tower totals a height of only 50 metres, climbing across 9 floors with a radial form designed to optimise privacy, promoting natural light and panoramic views to the adjacent beach, yacht club, and the harbour. Generous ground floor residences enjoy private landscaped gardens with plunge pools, while halffloor top-floor penthouses enjoy wraparound private landscaped terraces, and 16 meter length private pools.
